name: AG News: News Topic Classification Benchmark
description: AG News is a benchmark dataset for text topic classification constructed by Xiang Zhang, Junbo Zhao, and Yann LeCun (NeurIPS 2015) from Antonio Gulli's AG corpus of news articles. The dataset contains 120,000 training samples and 7,600 test samples equally distributed across 4 topical classes: World, Sports, Business, and Sci/Tech. Each sample consists of the news article title and description fields gathered by the ComeToMyHead academic search engine across more than 2,000 news sources between 2004 and 2005.

publisher.name: University of Pisa & New York University

license.name: Academic Research Use / Proprietary News Content
license.notes: Original news corpus was crawled by ComeToMyHead from >2,000 news sources and provided for non-commercial academic research. Underlying article text remains copyrighted by source news publishers. The 4-class classification subset formatted by Zhang et al. (2015) has no explicit open commercial license.
